job.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (all genders) - Storefront Hosting

tailoring.headline: Senior Technical Product Manager & E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Senior Developer and E-Commerce Specialist with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, integrating, and supporting large-scale platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong background in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, cloud deployments, and CI/CD pipelines. Bridges business requirements and technical architecture, driving requirements engineering, user stories, and data pipelines across global enterprise systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Technical Product Manager (all genders) - Storefront Hosting
cover_en.hook: As SCAYLE scales high-performance enterprise e-commerce platforms worldwide, building robust hosting environments and developer tooling is paramount. Bringing over 5 years of enterprise platform delivery experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my techno-functional expertise to your storefront hosting ecosystem.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Ownership & Architecture
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation, I engineered and coordinated complex backend architectures on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), managing product catalogs, pricing, and integrations across global channels.

bullets.label: API Design & Data Integration
bullets.text: I designed and exposed headless OCC REST APIs and built robust data pipelines connecting enterprise PIM, ERP, and MDM systems to ensure seamless multi-system synchronization.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Bridging
bullets.text: Acting between business stakeholders and engineering teams, I regularly translated complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, and scalable technical solutions.

bullets.label: Cloud Deployments & Release Management
bullets.text: At Shell, I executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and platform maintenance on cloud portals (CCv2), ensuring high availability and robust production support.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience supports SCAYLE's growth.

tailoring.why_company: SCAYLE is driving the future of enterprise e-commerce with remarkable speed, innovation, and a strong engineering culture. I am inspired by your mission to provide powerful, scalable D2C architectures and developer-first cloud solutions. My extensive enterprise background bridging backend engineering, API integration, and stakeholder requirements at Rockwell Automation and Shell makes me eager to contribute directly to SCAYLE's storefront hosting success.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, API design, and techno-functional analysis at Rockwell Automation and Shell to drive scalable storefront hosting solutions at SCAYLE.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a Senior E-Commerce & Backend Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in APIs, cloud platforms, and techno-functional delivery. I've applied for the Senior Technical Product Manager - Storefront Hosting role at SCAYLE and would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Technical Product Manager (all genders) - Storefront Hosting - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Technical Product Manager (all genders) - Storefront Hosting role at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG / SCAYLE.

With over 5 years of enterprise platform experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API design, cloud deployments, and techno-functional requirements engineering.

I hold a valid German residence and work permit, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to speaking with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
